public_headers_preserved.name: exists_positiveReferenceFiniteRadialJets
public_headers_preserved.header:
theorem exists_positiveReferenceFiniteRadialJets
    {F : Set ℝ} (hF : IsClosed F) {l r : ℝ}
    (hl : l ∉ F) (hr : r ∉ F) (hlr : l < r)
    {a b : Bool → ℝ} {y h : Bool → PolarPoint → ℝ}
    (hab : ∀ side, a side < b side)
    (hc : ∀ side, (if side then r else l) ∈ Icc (a side) (b side))
    (hy : ∀ side, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (y side)
      (Ioo (a side) (b side) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)))
    (hh : ∀ side, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (h side)
      (Ioo (a side) (b side) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)))
    (hyc : ∀ side θ, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (y side) (if side then r else l, θ))
    (hhc : ∀ side θ, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (h side) (if side then r else l, θ))
    (hyr : ∀ side x, x ∈ Ioo (a side) (b side) → ∀ θ,
      y side (x, θ) = y side (x, 0))
    (hhr : ∀ side x, x ∈ Ioo (a side) (b side) → ∀ θ,
      h side (x, θ) = h side (x, 0))
    (hyvalue : ∀ side, y side (if side then r else l, 0) =
      (if side then (1 : ℝ) else 0))
    (hyslope : ∀ side, 0 < deriv (fun x : ℝ => y side (x, 0))
      (if side then r else l))
    (hhpositive : ∀ side, 0 < h side (if side then r else l, 0))
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    ∃ Y H : ℝ → ℝ,
      PositiveChartRangeGeometry (positiveReferenceCylinderChart Y)
        (positiveReferenceCylinderInverse Y) (fun p : PolarPoint => H p.1) l r 0 1 ∧
      (∀ x ∈ F, H x = 1) ∧
      (∀ side θ k, k ≤ n →
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun p : PolarPoint => Y p.1)
            (if side then r else l, θ) =
          iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (y side) (if side then r else l, θ)) ∧
      (∀ side θ k, k ≤ n →
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun p : PolarPoint => H p.1)
            (if side then r else l, θ) =
          iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (h side) (if side then r else l, θ))

public_headers_preserved.name: coordinatePrincipalDensity_radial_cylinder
public_headers_preserved.header:
theorem coordinatePrincipalDensity_radial_cylinder
    {A : SymmetricCoefficients} {Y H : ℝ → ℝ} {p : PolarPoint}
    (hY : DifferentiableAt ℝ Y p.1) :
    let B := coordinatePrincipalDensity A (positiveReferenceCylinderChart Y)
      (fun q : PolarPoint => H q.1)
    B.a p = H p.1 ^ 2 / |deriv Y p.1| * (A.a p * deriv Y p.1 ^ 2) ∧
      B.b p = H p.1 ^ 2 / |deriv Y p.1| * (A.b p * deriv Y p.1) ∧
      B.c p = H p.1 ^ 2 / |deriv Y p.1| * A.c p

public_headers_preserved.header:
theorem divergenceOperator_radial_height_of_coefficient_germs
    {A : SymmetricCoefficients} {w H : ℝ → ℝ} {p : PolarPoint}
    (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w) (hH : ContDiff ℝ ∞ H)
    (ha : A.a =ᶠ[𝓝 p] (fun q : PolarPoint => w q.1))
    (hb : A.b =ᶠ[𝓝 p] (fun _ : PolarPoint => (0 : ℝ))) :
    divergenceOperator A (fun q : PolarPoint => H q.1) p =
      deriv (fun r => w r * deriv H r) p.1

public_headers_preserved.name: inverseChartPotential_radial_cylinder
public_headers_preserved.header:
theorem inverseChartPotential_radial_cylinder
    {A : SymmetricCoefficients} {w Y H : ℝ → ℝ} {p : PolarPoint}
    (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w) (hH : ContDiff ℝ ∞ H)
    (hY : DifferentiableAt ℝ Y (Function.invFun Y p.1))
    (hYpos : 0 < deriv Y (Function.invFun Y p.1))
    (ha : A.a =ᶠ[𝓝 (positiveReferenceCylinderInverse Y p)]
      (fun q : PolarPoint => w q.1))
    (hb : A.b =ᶠ[𝓝 (positiveReferenceCylinderInverse Y p)]
      (fun _ : PolarPoint => (0 : ℝ))) :
    inverseChartPotential A (positiveReferenceCylinderChart Y)
      (positiveReferenceCylinderInverse Y) (fun q : PolarPoint => H q.1) p =
        H (Function.invFun Y p.1) *
          deriv (fun r => w r * deriv H r) (Function.invFun Y p.1) /
            deriv Y (Function.invFun Y p.1)

public_headers_preserved.header:
theorem wholePositiveReferenceGauge_geometry
    {ψ χ τ σ : PolarPoint → PolarPoint} {h₀ Q : PolarPoint → ℝ}
    {l r u v c d : ℝ}
    (H₀ : PositiveChartRangeGeometry ψ χ h₀ l r u v)
    (H : WholePositiveChartGeometry σ τ (wholePositiveChartHeight σ Q) l r c d) :
    PositiveChartRangeGeometry (wholePositiveReferenceGaugeChart ψ σ)
      (wholePositiveReferenceGaugeInverse τ χ)
      (wholePositiveReferenceGaugeHeight h₀ σ Q) l r u v

public_headers_preserved.name: wholePositiveReferenceGauge_middle_germs
public_headers_preserved.header:
theorem wholePositiveReferenceGauge_middle_germs
    {ψ χ τ σ : PolarPoint → PolarPoint} {h₀ Q : PolarPoint → ℝ}
    {l r u v c d : ℝ}
    (H₀ : PositiveChartRangeGeometry ψ χ h₀ l r u v)
    (H : WholePositiveChartGeometry σ τ (wholePositiveChartHeight σ Q) l r c d)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Icc c d) (θ : ℝ) :
    (wholePositiveReferenceGaugeChart ψ σ =ᶠ[𝓝 (x, θ)] ψ) ∧
      (wholePositiveReferenceGaugeHeight h₀ σ Q =ᶠ[𝓝 (x, θ)] h₀) ∧
      (wholePositiveReferenceGaugeInverse τ χ =ᶠ[𝓝 (ψ (x, θ))] χ)

public_headers_preserved.name: wholePositiveReferenceGauge_reference
public_headers_preserved.header:
theorem wholePositiveReferenceGauge_reference
    (ψ χ : PolarPoint → PolarPoint) (h₀ : PolarPoint → ℝ)
    {τ σ : PolarPoint → PolarPoint} {Q : PolarPoint → ℝ}
    (hτ : τ = id) (hσ : σ = id) (hQ : Q = (fun _ => 1)) :
    wholePositiveReferenceGaugeChart ψ σ = ψ ∧
      wholePositiveReferenceGaugeInverse τ χ = χ ∧
      wholePositiveReferenceGaugeHeight h₀ σ Q = h₀

public_headers_preserved.name: wholePositiveReferenceGauge_relative_fields
public_headers_preserved.header:
theorem wholePositiveReferenceGauge_relative_fields
    {ψ χ τ σ : PolarPoint → PolarPoint} {h₀ Q : PolarPoint → ℝ}
    (hχψ : Function.LeftInverse χ ψ) (hστ : Function.LeftInverse σ τ)
    (hh₀ : ∀ p, h₀ p ≠ 0) :
    wholePositiveReferenceGaugeInverse τ χ ∘ ψ = τ ∧
      χ ∘ wholePositiveReferenceGaugeChart ψ σ = σ ∧
      ∀ p, h₀ p / wholePositiveReferenceGaugeHeight h₀ σ Q (τ p) = Q p
